narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>One is small and one is tilted. They look different, so they cannot be similar.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Turning a rectangle does not change its sides. Size alone does not decide shape.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Only the ratio of width to height can tell us.
